name: io.github.MagzhanSan/snowleo-risk
title: Snow Leo Risk & Compliance
description: Screen names against OFAC, EU and UN lists; check CVEs, domain DNS and WHOIS, and public tenders

io.apify.authentication: OAuth with the user's own Apify account, or an Apify API token in the Authorization header
io.apify.billing: The connecting user's own Apify account is billed per result; there is no key to buy from the publisher

measured: Sanctions screening joins US Treasury OFAC SDN (19,388), the EU consolidated list (6,234) and the UN Security Council list (1,011) into 26,633 records against the 19,388 in OFAC alone; 4,370 names are listed by two or more authorities and 1,693 by all three.
The whole NIST National Vulnerability Database, 389,995 CVEs, joined with CISA KEV and EPSS.

One row per domain with 80 fields: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, the CNAME chain, DNSSEC, SPF/DKIM/DMARC posture checked against the standards, the WHOIS registration record and the TLS certificate. Monitor mode returns only domains whose records moved, with what changed.

Public procurement from EU TED, UK Find a Tender, UK Contracts Finder and US SAM.gov in one row shape: 48 buyer countries in a single measured window, 47 of them in one 7-day slice of TED holding 19,795 notices (4-11 Sep 2026).
